app.title: Atalaia · Game control
app.reconnecting: No connection to the field controller. Reconnecting…

login.intro: The organisers' console, served by the field controller.
login.expired: The access code is no longer accepted. Please enter it again.
login.hint: The controller shows the codes with: python3 -m atalaia_controller tokens

alerts.radio_down: Radio down: the USB modem does not answer.
alerts.node_offline: Box {node} has not been heard for more than 90 s.

game.title: Game
game.name: Game name
game.teams_hint: Separated by commas, in the order of the buttons (for example: red, blue).
game.modifiers_hint: They run alongside the mode on every box (for example keypad codes).
game.wait_gm: The organisers have not created a game yet.
game.standby_notice: This controller is on standby in this game: it follows the main controller and only takes charge if promoted.
game.not_leader: This controller is not in charge of the game. To run it from here, promote it in the Controller tab.

controller.title: Field controller
controller.confirm_promote: This controller will take charge of the game. Continue?
controller.promote_hint: Promote a standby controller when the main one stops answering (manual failover, ADR-P2-8).

score.title: Score
score.timeline: Score over time since the console opened
score.explain: Each box's points (the highest value it reported) added up, plus the organisers' adjustments.

nodes.title: Boxes
nodes.none: No boxes in this game yet.
nodes.name: Name

field.title: Field
field.bad_type: The field image must be PNG, JPEG or WebP.
field.no_image: No field image: the boxes are shown on a grid.
field.drag_hint: Drag the boxes to where they are on the field.

join.title: Join boxes and controllers
join.intro: Make the join data for a box (NFC card or serial console) or for a standby controller.
join.warning: Careful: this code and the card carry the game key. Show them only to the people setting up the field.
join.qr_label: QR code with the join data
join.copy_failed: Could not copy: select the text and copy it by hand.
join.nfc_hint: Bytes to write to the card's memory from page 4 (NDEF message).
join.no_game: No game is running on this controller.
join.standby_intro: Paste the text the main controller made for a standby controller. Both controllers must share the same field join key.
join.standby_done: This controller is now on standby in game {game}.
join.gm_only: Only the organisers can make join data.
join.standby_cannot_issue: A standby controller does not make join data; use the controller in charge.

scoreboard.title: Scoreboard
scoreboard.token_needed: Open the scoreboard with the read code in its address: …/scoreboard.html#token=CODE
